notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.1

Fixed an issue where the cloud on the map would not disappear in certain instances after Chapter 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983387/386d0755472375d8e6ba12188ef3fd69ba3ae7db.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
You can now select the "Apprentice" difficulty level, which is equivalent to an easy mode. Mana crystals will spawn more frequently, making mana management easier.

The "Warmage" difficulty level is the game's default difficulty level.

You can adjust the difficulty at the beginning of each level on the spell selection screen.

In addition, I have made some minor visual improvements.

Have fun playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983387/faf934ceed3bde7dbb9830e0e77e34bd1fc4cc2e.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 is now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Changelog:

- Fixed an issue on the "Stats" tab where the "Battles Won" stat would reset after completing the "Hostile Dreams" side quest.

- Minor bug fixes.[/b]

notes.title: New Update Available!
notes.notes:
1.0.4 Patch Notes:

- Fixed an issue on Chapter 3/Level 6 where a chest would still show as available for pickup even if its collected.
- Fixed the HP slider for the "Grey Queen" in NG+.
- Difficulty of the "Hostile Dreams" side quest balanced in NG+.

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]Hi,

I've uploaded the new update, which includes minor bug fixes:[/b]

[i]- Fixed the hitboxes of the "Frozen Crawler" and "Worm" enemies.

- Fixed the "Mage of the Flame Legion" enemy attack, where the player is still damaged for a while after the visual.

- Bloom level was too strong on the "Don't Shoot the Survivors" and "Stalker Ambush" side quests - fixed.[/i]

[b]Thanks for your attention![/b]

notes.title: Difficulty balance update
notes.notes:
Hi!

Some players have mentioned that the game can be a bit too difficult at times, so I've done a bit of balancing on the difficulty. 

Thanks for the feedbacks, I'm working on making the game the best it can be for the release!

notes.title: TLWM Demo Updated - Aiming Line Added
notes.notes:
[b]Hello!

Considering player feedback, the game has been updated with an aiming line. 

It is enabled by default and can be toggled on or off in the Options > Controls menu. 

I hope this improves your gaming experience. 

[i]Thank you for playing![/i]
[/b]

notes.title: Aiming assist will be added soon!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Based on feedback, some players have found aiming to be difficult. Therefore, an aiming "laser" will be added to the demo soon, and the full game will also feature this option. 
It will be optional and can be toggled on or off in the settings. 

Thank you for your attention.
Have a nice day!
